meaningKo: 힘든 상황에서도 긍정적인 태도를 유지하라는 의미
exampleEn: Even though things are tough right now, just keep your chin up!
exampleKo: 지금 힘든 상황이지만, 긍정적인 태도를 유지해!
gameExamples: When facing challenges, remember to keep your chin up.
No matter how difficult the journey gets, you should always keep your chin up.
During hard times, it’s important to keep your chin up and stay hopeful.
